Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Kerala University Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Kerala University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Kerala University recruitment is Field Investigator. This is a contractual position. The university is looking for candidates to fill this role through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Field Investigator post announced by Kerala University. Candidates interested in this opportunity should ensure they meet the eligibility criteria before attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Field Investigator post, candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Life Sciences. This includes specializations such as Zoology, Botany, Biology, or other allied disciplines within life sciences.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Field Investigator position at Kerala University is scheduled to be held on 15 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this Kerala University recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue with their original and photocopies of documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position at Kerala University is a contractual job type. This means the employment will be for a fixed duration as per the terms and conditions specified by the university.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: For the walk-in interview, candidates must carry all original documents, including educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant certificates. Self-attested photocopies of these documents are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this Field Investigator recruitment. Candidates should confirm this by referring to the official notification before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Kerala University office in Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the exact address and reporting time.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Investigator post in Kerala University primarily involves a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance and qualifications during this interview.
